title: UX Researcher
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for UX Researcher: Run user research with study planning, interviews, usability tests, surveys, synthesis, insight communication, ethics, and product influence.

tree.name: Foundations and Role Context
tree.description: Understand what UX Researcher work looks like, which problems it solves, and the baseline concepts needed before building.

resources.title: How a top UX Researcher does Usability Testing with Figma & Lyssna (Sneak Peek)

children.name: Domain Basics
children.description: Learn the vocabulary, workflows, constraints, and decision-making patterns used by practitioners in this role.

children.name: Tooling and Daily Workflow
children.description: Set up the core tools, local environment, version control habits, debugging workflow, and documentation style.

tree.name: Core Skills and Implementation
tree.description: Build the practical skill stack for UX Researcher through small exercises, realistic constraints, and repeatable workflows.

resources.title: Easy Usability testing guide with example (Remote & in person) UX User research (UX Tshili)

children.name: Implementation Patterns
children.description: Practice common patterns, tradeoffs, reusable structures, naming, configuration, and problem decomposition.

children.name: Quality, Testing, and Review
children.description: Add checks, test cases, review criteria, failure handling, accessibility/security considerations, and regression prevention.

children.name: Practice: Focused Skill Drill
children.description: Take one realistic scenario, complete it under constraints, document assumptions, compare alternatives, and write a short retrospective.

tree.name: Production, Collaboration, and Operations
tree.description: Move beyond tutorials into maintainable work: reliability, handoff, monitoring, security, stakeholder communication, and lifecycle ownership.

resources.title: 15 User Research Methods to Know Beyond Usability Testing (NNgroup)

children.name: Security, Reliability, and Risk
children.description: Identify likely failure modes, protect sensitive data, define safe defaults, and make operational risks visible.

children.name: Team Delivery Workflow
children.description: Work with issues, pull requests, release notes, stakeholder demos, decision records, and measurable acceptance criteria.

tree.name: Portfolio and Career Readiness
tree.description: Turn your UX Researcher learning into proof: case studies, GitHub artifacts, demos, interview stories, and clear role positioning.

children.name: Case Study Writing
children.description: Write a concise case study with problem, constraints, decisions, implementation, validation, outcomes, and next improvements.

children.name: Project: UX Researcher Portfolio Capstone
children.description: Build a portfolio-grade UX Researcher project with a README, diagrams or screenshots, tests/checks, deployment or demo notes, and a lessons-learned section.
